subject: Staged purge & log-retention carveouts — coordination
messages:
From: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@helixhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Graham Lee <graham.lee@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Alignment on backup purge windows & log carveouts

Marcus —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our upcoming audit we need to confirm Redwood's practical retention and purge timings across three categories: user-generated payloads, system backups (full + incremental), and ephemeral logs (request traces, KV-cache traces). Our auditors want a proposed purge window and any available carveouts for short-term forensic logs before the purge runs.

High-level asks: 
- What is the typical retention you apply to backups before permanent purge? (snapshot + archive tiers)
- Can we request an exception to retain a 90-day forensic slice of request logs for specific accounts?
- How would a manual retention hold be enacted if we open a legal hold?

I've attached a short audit-scope doc. Happy to take a 30-min sync this week.

Thanks,
Carmen Diaz
Head of Security Ops, Helix Health

Attachment: AuditScope_Helix_2027-01.pdf (application/pdf, 245KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment on backup purge windows & log carveouts

Carmen —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers at a glance, then proposal below: 

- Backups: Hosted customers by default have a rolling 30-day snapshot retention. We maintain an additional 180-day cold archive for customers on Enterprise plans or under contractual carveouts; that archive is immutable once archived.
- Ephemeral logs (request traces / KV cache debug info): default 14 days. We can extend to 90 days for specific accounts under an exception but will need scope and justification (audit/legal). Extended retention increases storage-incident window and affects our RPO for restores.
- Legal hold: our Private/Dedicated customers can request a hold via Support/Legal; we toggle a retention flag in the control plane which prevents the scheduled purge. For Hosted accounts we require a signed DPA amendment and an Ops ticket; this creates a soft lock for 90 days while teams validate.

Proposal: schedule a short (30m) sync Thurs 1/14 to confirm Helix's scope. I'll loop in Kimberly (legal) and Neha (security) so we can capture DPA implications and operational runbook.

Work items I will bring: sample purge timeline CSV and an ops escalation runbook for manual holds.

- Marcus
Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-proposed-purge-timeline.csv (text/csv, stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@helixhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment on backup purge windows & log carveouts

Carmen / Marcus —

Thanks. A couple of legal points and requests we need captured before we commit to sustained exceptions: 

1) Subprocessor implication: any extended log retention that would persist in backups handled by a subprocessor requires us to enumerate the subprocessor list in the DPA. Please confirm if Helix requires storage to be moved into a specific region or provider. If so, we need to list that provider as a subprocessor and agree on the subprocessors' security controls.

2) Scope & minimization: for audit purposes we require a precise account list (account IDs) and the specific log buckets/indices and approximate egress size. We cannot accept an open-ended "retain everything 90 days" request.

3) Legal hold flow: we will execute a DPA amendment for per-account retention holds; amendment must include: effective date, list of accounts, retention end date, and proof-of-request (signed SOW/PO). Our standard amendment permits a 90-day hold; anything beyond that needs exec approval.

I'm attaching our DPA questionnaire with the subprocessor section highlighted — please fill and return. Also note that if extended retention is approved, we'll add a configurable flag in the Private control plane and a billing SKU for extended storage.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Helix_DPA_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, stub)

From: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@helixhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Graham Lee <graham.lee@helixhealth.com>, audit@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment on backup purge windows & log carveouts

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clarity. We can provide a scoped list of 12 account IDs and the buckets/indices we expect to retain. Helix does not require a provider change — we are fine with your current subprocessor list as long as it is disclosed in the DPA amendment.

We also want the following in the mutual action plan: 
- A 90-day exception for forensic request-trace logs for the listed accounts (explicit indices)
- A one-time, timeboxed snapshot export before the first purge run for our auditors (read-only export to our S3 assuming proper consent)
- A documented rollback path if the extended window causes restore regressions

Could we confirm these as action items on the Thurs 1/14 sync? I attached the audit scope.

Carmen

Attachment: AuditScope_Helix_2027-01.pdf (application/pdf, updated)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@helixhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Alignment on backup purge windows & log carveouts

Forwarding the confirmed notes from today's sync: 

Summary (ops commitments):
- Redwood will implement a scoped 90-day retention exception for the 12 Helix account IDs provided. Exception will apply to request-trace indices only (names provided in the sync).
- We will perform a one-time export snapshot in read-only S3 bucket controlled by Helix prior to the first scheduled purge (target: 2027-01-21). Export will be encrypted and transfer audited.
- Default hosted retention remains unchanged (30-day snapshots, 14-day ephemeral logs) for other accounts.
- Manual legal hold flow: Helix to sign DPA amendment, which Kimberly will circulate. Once signed, Ops toggles the retention flag; snapshot/export is scheduled.
- Rollback path: if restore regression or increased incidence occurs, Ops will pause the purge run for up to 7 days and run diagnostics; legal will be looped for potential reduction in retention window.

Action items: 
1) Helix: send account IDs and indices list (due: 2027-01-15 EOD)
2) Kimberly: circulate DPA amendment draft (due: 2027-01-16)
3) Priyom/Marcus: schedule export and confirm encryption keys (due: 2027-01-19)

Thanks everyone — I have created the internal ticket RED-OPS-7834 and added the runbook checklist.

Priyom Das
SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-proposed-purge-timeline.csv (ops), AuditScope_Helix_2027-01.pdf (from Helix)
